info.name: Pravzo Unified API v2.0
info.description:
Single merged Postman collection for Pravzo Unified Backend (PORT 5000).

Admin routes: /api/admin/* and /api/super-admin/*
User/Rider routes: /api/auth/*, /api/users/*, /api/bookings/*, etc.

Setup:
1. Run Admin Login to get ADMIN_TOKEN
2. Run User Register/Login to get USER_TOKEN
3. Use respective token for each section

item.name: [ADMIN] Admin Management
item.description: SUPER_ADMIN only - Enterprise admin management with branch assignments, permissions, activity tracking, login history, and session management. Complete admin lifecycle with 20 endpoints.

request.description: Create new admin account. Auto-generates secure password (12+ chars) and sends credentials via email. Activity is logged. Only SUPER_ADMIN can access.

query.description: Filter: SUPER_ADMIN | ADMIN | CONTENT_ADMIN | SUPPORT_ADMIN | REPORT_ADMIN | FINANCE_ADMIN | FLEET_ADMIN
Filter: ACTIVE | BLOCKED | INACTIVE | SUSPENDED | PENDING | LOCKED

request.description: Get paginated list of all admins with search and filters. Includes creator information. Only SUPER_ADMIN can access.
Get admin statistics dashboard - total admins, active/blocked counts, role distribution, today/monthly registrations. Only SUPER_ADMIN can access.
Get complete admin profile including creator details and last login. Only SUPER_ADMIN can access.
Update admin details (name, phone, role, department). Email cannot be changed. Activity is logged. Only SUPER_ADMIN can access.
Block an admin account. Cannot block yourself. Reason is required and logged. Only SUPER_ADMIN can access.
Unblock a blocked admin. Sets status to ACTIVE. Activity is logged. Only SUPER_ADMIN can access.
Reset admin password. New secure random password is auto-generated and sent via email. Password history is tracked. Force change flag is set. Activity is logged. Only SUPER_ADMIN can access.
Soft delete an admin (sets deleted_at). Cannot delete yourself. Activity is logged. Only SUPER_ADMIN can access.
Get complete activity audit trail for an admin - all actions, IP addresses, user agents, timestamps. Paginated. Only SUPER_ADMIN can access.
Update admin status. Valid statuses: ACTIVE, INACTIVE, BLOCKED, SUSPENDED, PENDING, LOCKED. Activity is logged. Only SUPER_ADMIN can access.

Assign admin to a branch. One admin can have only ONE active assignment. One branch can have only ONE active admin. Assignment types: PRIMARY, TEMPORARY, BACKUP. Transaction-based. Only SUPER_ADMIN can access.
Transfer admin from current branch to another branch. Closes old assignment as TRANSFERRED, creates new assignment. Preserves complete history. Transaction-based. Only SUPER_ADMIN can access.
Remove admin from their current branch assignment. Admin goes into admin pool (no branch). Transaction-based. Only SUPER_ADMIN can access.
Get complete branch assignment history for an admin - all assignments, transfers, dates, reasons. Includes branch details and who assigned/unassigned. Only SUPER_ADMIN can access.
Get complete login history for an admin - success/failed logins, IP addresses, devices, browsers, OS, session durations. Paginated. Only SUPER_ADMIN can access.

Get module-level permissions for an admin - 14 modules (dashboard, users, riders, vehicles, bookings, rentals, jobs, reports, payments, notifications, settings, landing_cms, branches, admin_management). Only SUPER_ADMIN can access.
